Strive Math is a Singapore-based coding and math education provider on a mission to make learning more joyful and meaningful. We teach coding, math and custom STEM courses to kids aged 8 to 16, and build the tools to support teachers to deliver engaging learning experiences.

Strive is currently hiring one part-time coding and math teacher who is open to US teaching hours, and a full time teacher who is open to teaching in Singapore afternoons-evenings and later.

You will have the opportunity to transform kids’ lives by fundamentally reframing their confidence and perception of coding or math. What’s teacher training like?

I am learning while I teach. During class, the way a student thinks always amazes me. And the way they approach a problem would make me think like, wait why didn't I think of that? So, it's learning while teaching.
The fulfilment and sense of pride after every lesson of teaching a student.
Seeing the feeling of accomplishment a student has after solving problems.
Enjoying new ways of coding and thinking about how to better teach it (in the process, further deepening my understanding of some concepts).

I want to push myself by taking on new, more difficult opportunities. With Strive, I want to increase my knowledge since I want to take on problems and learn from them in order to see myself as a responsible person.
I look forward to teaching and this is helping prepare for some sort of teaching career in my future.

, Strive was built on a simple idea: in the real world, math is done with computers and code, yet students still calculate by hand. By turning abstract concepts into coding projects, we make learning more relevant, engaging, and joyful.

Since then, Strive has grown into products used by more than 8.5 million teachers and students around the world, and has taught STEM classes to thousands of students on its proprietary Learn platform. In 2023, by popular demand, Strive opened up this platform to anyone who wants to teach these modules or create their own unique content.
